up: Find all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4304757. For each molecule, provide: its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), maximum development phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles). Order the results by ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Ensure each distinct molecule is included only once. Use the docs table to identify the document, and link through compound_records to reach molecule_dictionary; then optionally join compound_structures for SMILES, but still include molecules without a SMILES entry. No other filters apply.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4304757' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
